posts.title: 为什么需要一个长期维护的个人主页

image.alt: 抽象的个人主页结构示意图

posts.summary: 个人主页不只是展示页面，也是一套让项目、思考和身份持续沉淀的容器。
body: 一个长期主页的价值，在于它能把分散在社交平台、文档和聊天记录里的内容重新组织起来。
首版不需要一次写完所有真实内容。先建立稳定结构，再用真实项目和文章持续替换，占位内容会自然退出舞台。

posts.title: 把笔记当成系统，而不是仓库

image.alt: 分层笔记与知识节点示意图

posts.summary: 好的笔记系统不追求囤积，而是帮助自己在未来更快重新进入问题。
body: 笔记真正有用的时刻，通常不是保存那一刻，而是未来再次面对类似问题的时候。
因此，标签、摘要和上下文比完整复制资料更重要。它们让知识变得可重新调用。

posts.title: AI 工具如何进入日常工作流

image.alt: AI 工作流节点连接示意图

posts.summary: 把 AI 当成协作者，而不是按钮，可以更自然地嵌入研究、草拟和复盘。
body: AI 工具最适合处理开放问题中的结构化部分，比如拆解任务、生成备选方案和检查遗漏。
更重要的是保留自己的判断，让工具承担速度，让人负责方向。

posts.title: 小系统如何支持长期目标

image.alt: 小系统支持长期目标的阶梯示意图

posts.summary: 长期目标不一定靠宏大计划推进，很多时候需要的是可重复的小系统。
body: 真正能持续的目标，往往不是每天重新鼓起勇气，而是让下一步动作足够清晰、足够容易开始。
小系统的意义在于降低启动成本，并让反馈自然出现。

posts.title: 建立适合自己的复盘节奏

image.alt: 复盘节奏与循环记录示意图

posts.summary: 复盘不只是总结结果，也是重新校准方向和注意力的过程。
body: 好的复盘不需要很长，但需要足够诚实。它应该回答什么有效、什么消耗过高、下一轮要如何调整。
当复盘成为节奏，经验才更容易从事件变成判断。

projects.title: Storyverse Video Agent
projects.description: An AI video project focused on telling better stories through cinematic language.
details: The project is developing both a Studio workflow and an online platform, moving video creation beyond prompt-to-clip generation toward a more directorial storytelling process.
Key areas include cinematic language, story structure, character continuity, and creator-facing product experience.

projects.title: Longevity and Geroscience
projects.description: Researching intervention pathways for aging while shaping disease-focused and health-management products over time.
details: This work studies aging mechanisms, intervention targets, clinical feasibility, and commercialization paths.
The near-term focus is on directions that can validate products or pipelines; the long-term focus is geroscience as a systematic opportunity.

projects.title: Commercial Applications of Continual Learning
projects.description: Looking for both underlying breakthroughs in continual learning and practical business entry points.
details: Continual learning is not only content delivery. The central question is how people sustain motivation, feedback, and capability growth over time.
The project currently focuses on learning systems, personalized feedback, AI-supported companionship, and durable business models.

projects.title: Startup Financing and Strategy
projects.description: Leading financing, strategy, PR, and cross-functional work across startups by turning external resources into execution power.
details: I led or supported more than ten fundraising rounds across three startups, with total financing of roughly RMB 1.5 billion.
The work covered financing narratives, investor communication, transaction execution, strategy, PR, and cross-functional coordination.

projects.title: Legal, IP, and Corporate Governance
projects.description: Turning legal experience into long-term startup capability across transactions, governance, intellectual property, and risk management.
details: I have seven years of legal practice experience and have also led legal, IP, and governance work inside startups.
My focus is making legal judgment useful to real business: controlling risk while supporting product, financing, and organizational growth.

posts.title: Why a Long-Term Personal Home Matters

image.alt: Abstract structure of a personal homepage

posts.summary: A personal site is not only a profile. It is a durable container for projects, thinking, and identity.
body: The value of a long-term homepage is that it gathers what usually lives across social feeds, documents, and conversations.
The first version does not need to be complete. Build the structure first, then let real projects and articles replace the placeholders over time.

posts.title: Notes as a System, Not a Warehouse
posts.summary: Useful notes are not about hoarding. They help you return to a problem faster in the future.
body: Notes usually become valuable later, when you face a similar question and need to rebuild context quickly.
That makes tags, summaries, and source context more important than copying everything in full.

posts.title: Bringing AI Tools Into Daily Workflows

image.alt: Connected nodes in an AI workflow

posts.summary: Treating AI as a collaborator, not a button, makes it easier to use across research, drafting, and review.
body: AI tools are especially strong at structuring open-ended work: breaking down tasks, generating alternatives, and checking for gaps.
The important part is keeping your judgment in the loop. Let the tool provide speed, and let the person hold direction.

posts.title: How Small Systems Support Long-Term Goals

image.alt: Small systems forming steps toward a long-term goal

posts.summary: Long-term goals do not always need grand plans. They often need repeatable small systems.
body: Sustainable goals rarely depend on rebuilding motivation every day. They depend on making the next action clear and easy to start.
Small systems reduce the cost of beginning and make useful feedback easier to notice.

posts.title: Finding a Review Rhythm That Works
posts.summary: Review is not only about summarizing outcomes. It also recalibrates direction and attention.
body: A useful review does not need to be long, but it does need to be honest. It should ask what worked, what cost too much, and what needs to change next.
When review becomes a rhythm, experience is more likely to become judgment.
